property_summary: After any successful initialize with an ERC20 base token of d decimals (4<=d<=36, d!=18), c.price() must equal virtualBaseTokenReserves * 10**(36-d) / virtualNftReserves; the mutant stores address(0) as baseToken so it wrongly uses the native-token exponent of 18 and returns a different price.
change_summary: Assign the zero address to baseToken instead of _baseToken.
